assay.note: Bisulfite-converted DNA on the named Illumina array.

coefficients.transformation: Unchanged bytes from the pinned upstream checkout; local filename may differ.

fixture_manifest.transformation: Project-authored manifest around unchanged, checksummed upstream public fixtures. No expected values generated by the implementation under test.

genome_build_note: Genome build is not required for this exact-ID score profile because no coordinate mapping is performed. Unknown build remains unknown. Coordinate-based or cross-platform mapping is unsupported.

missing_data.note: All 353 features must occur exactly once and have finite beta values. The upstream tutorial has imputation branches; they are outside this normalized score-only profile.

modality.note: DNA methylation beta values, not methylation M-values.

name: Horvath 2013 multi-tissue DNA methylation age
notes: A passing score-v1 run establishes fixture-specific computational reproduction only.
The original publication includes validation studies; this toolkit does not assess their applicability to a submitted sample or population.
Normalized fixture provenance is inherited from the pinned upstream reference run; this project independently recomputes the scoring stage.
Missing metadata blocks computation. Matching declarations allow conditional computation, not independently verified sample processing.

platform.note: Original study platforms. Runtime fixture is 27K-derived. EPIC, EPIC v2, targeted assays and sequencing are unsupported by this initial profile.

preprocessing.note: Already calibrated by the publisher BMIQcalibration workflow using Additional file 22 goldstandard2. No normalization is performed here. A method name, evidence record, and matching input checksum are required; provenance remains caller-declared.

sample_type.note: DNA assayed for methylation from the declared tissue.
